description:
Priority: P1 (process). File: .claude/scripts/session-start.sh. Reference: aviary/keystore/metricstore/carnegie.

Problem: The template is the only server-template whose cloud session-start script lacks the block that rewrites GitHub URLs with GITHUB_TOKEN, so cloud sessions can't fetch private git crates (e.g. a *-client dependency).

Change: Copy the `git config --global url."https://x-access-token:${GITHUB_TOKEN}@github.com/".insteadOf ...` block from a sibling's script.

Acceptance: a cloud session can resolve a private git dependency.
title: [TPL-012] Add the GITHUB_TOKEN git-auth block to session-start.sh
